# Data Processor Architecture

This is a placeholder for the data processor architecture diagram.

The DAFCOM Data Processor architecture includes:

1. Input Data Sources:
   - Meteorological Data
   - Satellite AOD Data
   - Air Quality Observations
   - Emissions Data
   - Land Use/Land Cover Data

2. Processing Components:
   - File I/O (NetCDF, CSV, HDF5 handlers)
   - Spatial Processing (regridding, interpolation)
   - Temporal Processing (alignment, resampling)
   - Quality Control
   - Data Fusion
   - Feature Engineering

3. Output Data Products:
   - ML Training Datasets
   - Validation Datasets
   - Forecast Model Inputs
   - Visualization Data

4. Processing Modes:
   - Reanalysis Mode (for historical data)
   - Forecast Mode (for operational predictions)
